title: Discovery of Seven Women's Bodies Intensifies Femicide Outrage in South Africa
detail: The discovery of seven women's bodies in South Africa has intensified public outrage over the country's persistent femicide crisis. Activists warn 'we are prey' as gender-based violence remains one of the nation's most severe social challenges, with South Africa recording some of the world's highest rates of femicide.

media.caption: Activists rally against femicide in South Africa following discovery of seven women's bodies
